name: ALMA Office
subtitle: Run your business in one place
promotionalText: Customers, money, messages, work, and a metered AI business assistant in one bilingual office.
description:
ALMA Office helps founders, creators, solo operators, and small teams manage daily business operations from one secure workspace.

Use ALMA to organize customers, conversations, tasks, estimates, invoices, payments, expenses, receipts, documents, reports, and approvals. When your workspace includes AI, ALMA can help draft replies, summarize activity, analyze supported documents, and prepare suggested actions without bypassing your permissions or usage limits.

Key capabilities:
• Customers and CRM activity
• Unified business inbox for configured channels
• Tasks, appointments, estimates, and invoices
• Income, expenses, receipts, and accountant-ready reports
• English and Spanish
• Approval-controlled business actions
• Optional metered AI assistance
• Camera, document, microphone, and notification support

ALMA is a business organization and preparation tool. It is not a bank, payroll processor, tax filing service, law firm, or licensed accountant.
